title: Nominalization
description: Turning verbs and adjectives into nouns.

items.translation: Common suffixes: -tion, -ment, -age, -ure, or no suffix at all
items.exampleFr: Créer → la création ; changer → le changement.
items.exampleEn: To create → creation; to change → change.

items.exampleFr: Beau → la beauté ; triste → la tristesse.
Le musée ouvre demain. → Ouverture du musée demain.
items.exampleEn: The museum opens tomorrow. → Museum opening tomorrow.
